svg.text: Simulation Benchmarks: Ours vs. Standard Pooled World Model
Shared frozen support/query protocols; the pooled baseline receives no test-time adaptation.
Task-specific metric: endpoint error (Event80/multi-background), final displacement error (gravity/collision/mass×friction), bar tilt MAE (balance), and yellow-light score MAE.
All reported LPIPS values use the official AlexNet network; blank cells indicate unavailable or withheld metrics.
